reuse.why: Builds a shared getMonthActionCategories/shouldSetMonthBudget pair, but copyPreviousMonth does not use it, the #fixed check is a hand-written regex instead of the tree's extractTagsFromText (shared/tags.ts), and the last-month sign inversion is re-written rather than shared with the averages.

duplication.why: The hidden/#fixed/saved-template rule is written twice (shouldSetMonthBudget and copyPreviousMonth's inline condition), and the has_saved_templates CASE plus notes join is duplicated between getBudgetData and getMonthActionCategories.

placement.why: Selection logic sits in server/budget/actions.ts with the actions and the new method is registered in budget/app.ts like its siblings; the template-source rule duplicates SQL that other budget modules already express.

scope.why: Changes are confined to month-wide actions, the new method and their tests.

maintainability.why: A future change to which categories month-wide actions fill must be made in two places (predicate and copyPreviousMonth) and in two SQL queries, which is exactly what the helper was meant to prevent.

bypasses_abstraction.where: copyPreviousMonth re-implements the shouldSetMonthBudget rule inline; both sites bypass extractTagsFromText with their own #fixed regex.

disguised_duplication.where: copyPreviousMonth's condition in actions.ts is shouldSetMonthBudget reshaped (negated, reordered, income check split out), and getBudgetData's added CASE/notes join copies getMonthActionCategories' selection columns.

abstraction_drift.where: shouldSetMonthBudget gained includeHiddenCategories; copyPreviousMonth keeps its own copy of the rule and threads the flag into that copy instead of calling the helper.
